limitations: Point samples do not cover every crossed cell; narrow ridges and azimuth gaps can be missed.
Adaptive step uses the last selected resolution; a boundary or NoData island between samples can be missed.
Complete means all planned samples in the requested range; excludes the unsampled observer-to-start interval and terrain beyond range.
Registration, pixel resolution and source seams remain uncertain; no physical accuracy or visibility guarantee.
Range convergence is not established by a single run. No refraction or sloped ground normal is used.
SPHERICAL_BODY_DISK_APPROXIMATION: effective radius is arithmetic mean of PCK axes; Earth flattening is not resolved.
Equal projected-area finite disk samples; bounds apply only to these samples and the sampled terrain model.
No horizon interpolation. Uncomputed rays remain UNKNOWN. No physical FULL/NONE guarantee between samples.
LT+S uses corrected centre distance for radius; differential aberration across the disk is neglected.
Solar disk fraction is not electrical power; Earth disk fraction is not RF link availability.
ABSOLUTE_REGISTRATION_NOT_VERIFIED; no atmospheric refraction or source alignment correction.
Artifact regression assertions verify this fresh run and actual raster hashes; they do not independently validate astronomy.
